fusions.name: Shoal of Slurry
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 gobs of wet mortar in a spread; each deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Load
fusions.desc: Skims a slick load of mortar off the trowel at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slick Render
fusions.desc: Coats you in wet render that raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 12% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Skim-Coat Slip
fusions.desc: After you move a set distance, a skin of wet mortar wards you, absorbing damage equal to 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
